$comment: Deno config for the pay-online edge function and its unit tests.
Sits at the repo root because Deno resolves its config from the working
directory, so `deno test supabase/tests` has to find it from here.
The tests live OUTSIDE supabase/functions/ on purpose: `supabase functions
deploy` uploads the whole function folder, so test files and their dev
dependencies would otherwise ship to production for no reason.
is what deno lint's no-import-prefix / no-unversioned-import rules want, and
it pins the version so the tests cannot drift under us.
